citations.claim: 1 in 10 medical products in developing countries is estimated to be substandard or falsified
citations.quote: According to WHO (2017), an estimated 1 in 10 medical products in low- and middle-income countries is substandard or falsified.

citations.claim: Monthly drug alert list of Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) drugs released by CDSCO
citations.source: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), Government of India
citations.quote: According to CDSCO Monthly Drug Alert notices, regulatory authorities routinely inspect and flag batches failing standard quality parameters.

citations.claim: Elderly population projections and chronic disease burden in India
citations.source: Longitudinal Ageing Study in India (LASI) Wave-1, MoHFW
citations.quote: According to LASI Wave-1 (MoHFW, 2021), a substantial proportion of elderly Indians manage two or more chronic health conditions simultaneously.
